_comment: Oracle for the mixed_guards scenario. Four calls to one @torch.compile-d function isolate three guard categories against the first (8,4) float32 contiguous call: (16,4)=size, (8,4) float64=dtype, (4,8).t()=stride (same shape (8,4), non-contiguous). Derived from the committed mixed_guards.log. NOTE: the third recompile (compile_id 0/3) lists, besides the defining stride failure against the float32 entries (0/0, 0/1), an incidental dtype failure against the float64 entry (0/2) -- that is normal, dynamo reports the failing guard against every cached entry. The recompile's defining new condition is the stride/contiguity change. Tool 1's analyzer is expected to produce three clusters, one per category, with category-appropriate suggestions.

expected_clusters.guard_text_example: tensor 'x' size mismatch at index 0. expected 8, actual 16
tensor 'x' dtype mismatch. expected Float, actual Double
tensor 'x' stride mismatch at index 0. expected 4, actual 1
